item.title: 🟠 OpenSSL HollowByte Flaw Could Freeze Server Memory with 11-Byte TLS Requests
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.

item.title: 🔵 n8n Token Exchange Flaw Could Let Attackers Log In as Users From Another Issuer
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact email access or mail flow — monitor delivery and client issues.
n8n, the workflow automation platform, handed out the wrong accounts at login. On Enterprise instances configured to trust more than one external token issuer, it matched an incoming JWT to a local user on the sub claim alone and ignored iss. item.description:
